dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Though it is not as extensive as the Kujou Clan's estate, I find it comfortable enough.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: So everything here was built according to your designs? I did not know you possessed such abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: If we ever need to expand the Kujou Clan residence, I'll be sure to find you.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: What's the matter? Are you unwilling to assist?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Heh, either way, I'm not here to twist your arm. You needn't worry.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: In fact, there is little that can be changed about the Kujou Clan residence. I mean, it would never become a place like this, at least.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I've never visited a place filled with such vitality and happiness...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I have not yet mentioned any specifics and you already agree so readily?
